about: Conformance vectors for verifying a signed drop. Each vector is self-contained: pass manifest, bundle_sha256, keys (the passport's /bots/{p}/keys list, null = unknown passport), the revocation inputs and (optionally) the bundle bytes to a verifier, and expect.reason. Reason codes are stable. Signed with a throwaway test key (tools/conformance/test-keys), never an agent key. Reference verifier: python/sdk/src/windy_drops/lib/verify.py.

vectors.name: valid
vectors.description: A genuine signed drop: every check passes.

vectors.name: valid_signature_band_below_minimum
vectors.description: Authentic (every check passes) but the signer's band (poor) is below the surface's minimum (fair): authenticity ok, POLICY refuses with band_below_minimum.

vectors.name: bundle_sha_mismatch
vectors.description: The downloaded bundle bytes do not hash to the registry's bundle_sha256.

vectors.name: no_signature
vectors.description: The manifest has no signature block (refuse unsigned by default).

vectors.name: bad_algorithm
vectors.description: signature.algorithm is not ES256.

vectors.name: no_passport
vectors.description: signature.signer.passport is missing.

vectors.name: no_jws
vectors.description: A legacy raw signature with no JWS (refused).

vectors.name: digest_mismatch
vectors.description: The manifest was edited after signing (version bumped).

vectors.name: bad_jws_format
vectors.description: The JWS is not detached compact form.

vectors.name: bad_header
vectors.description: The protected header typ is wrong.

vectors.name: passport_mismatch
vectors.description: The JWS header binds a different passport than signature.signer.passport.

vectors.name: bad_sig_length
vectors.description: The raw signature is not 64 bytes.

vectors.name: passport_revoked
vectors.description: The signer passport is on the Eternitas revocation list.

vectors.name: key_revoked
vectors.description: The signing key (kid) is on the Eternitas revocation list.

vectors.name: passport_suspended
vectors.description: The signer passport is suspended (reversible).

vectors.name: unknown_passport
vectors.description: Eternitas does not know the passport (404).

vectors.name: unknown_key
vectors.description: The passport has keys, but not this kid.

vectors.name: bad_key_type
vectors.description: The key is not an EC P-256 ES256 signing key.

vectors.name: kid_mismatch
vectors.description: The key's thumbprint does not match its kid label.

vectors.name: key_not_active
vectors.description: The signing key has been retired.

vectors.name: bad_signature
vectors.description: Everything checks out except the signature bytes (one bit flipped).
